verdicts.decision_note: The client requires page-speed review of the original Harborline site as well as HLX, establishing the visitor-facing performance behavior and its legacy-site scope.
First concrete failure evidence: injected plugin code disrupted caching and produced visitor load times exceeding 15 seconds.
First concrete post-cleanup verification: measured visitor-page loading improved from approximately 16 seconds to under 2 seconds.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports configuring the dedicated site-speed optimizations and provides resulting desktop and mobile performance scores.
First concrete post-optimization verification: Largest Contentful Paint indicates good loading speed on both mobile and desktop.
